filed_by: TI Sigma DPES agent on Brandon Emerick directive (Pass 26)
predecessor_studies: Pass-25 §2: r20 K=100 post-hoc Pearson r(R_t, AUC) = +0.0803, p=0.4254 (NULL)
hypothesis_under_test: On a fresh 3-SAT corpus seeded distinctly from r20, with K=500 mappings per instance, the Pearson correlation between per-mapping R_t (entropy-discounted attention concentration on softmax(-energies/T)) and per-mapping inverted-AUC ('higher-E ⇒ SAT') is positive and significant.

design.instance_seed_rationale: e-derived; deliberately distinct from r20's pi-derived seed=31415927.
design.mapping_seed_rationale: Independent per-(instance, k) seed of form (instance_seed * 10007) + (i * 31337) + k, identical recipe to r20.
design.R_t_definition: R_t(k) = 1 - H(softmax(-energies[:, k]/T)) / log(M); T = mean per-mapping std(energies). Frozen pre-data per #69.
design.scoring: Pearson r(R_t, per_map_inverted_AUC) across K=500 mappings; permutation null with n=10000.

rules.CONFIRM: r > 0.15 AND permutation_p_two_sided < 0.01 → §1.3 prediction CONFIRMED on fresh corpus; R_t is a meaningful within-model retrieval-quality proxy.
rules.WEAK_CONFIRM: r > 0.10 AND p < 0.05 → marginal positive evidence; third corpus required.
rules.NULL: r > 0 AND p >= 0.05 → trend-positive but underpowered; predictive value is empirically unsupported.
rules.DISCONFIRM: r <= 0 → §1.3 prediction REJECTED on fresh corpus; the joint RR(V,S,T̂) operator's only novel-falsifiable claim retired.

anti_hark_safeguards: Decision thresholds frozen in this JSON BEFORE the runner is executed.
T (softmax temperature) computed as mean per-mapping std(energies); frozen.
No re-runs with alternative seeds permitted.
Decision rule deterministic on primary metric; secondary metrics reported but do NOT trigger flip.
next_step_after_run: Append observed value + verdict to results.json; cite this prereg verbatim in the Pass-26 paper.
